sentences.text: The documents do not state the maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratio for gold loans in the bank’s FAQ.
The FAQ says the loan amount is a percentage of the assessed value of the gold ornaments, within the loan-to-value ceiling permitted under the applicable regulations.

The UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 say the LTV ratio has the same meaning as defined in the Reserve Bank of India (Urban Co-operative Banks – Credit Facilities) Directions, 2025, and require the bank to display the methodology used for determination of LTV ratio.
